role: all historical discovery; new goal conditions model capability probes, not heldout outcome validation

sampling.A: same frame,same whole RNG state repeated twice
sampling.B: same frame,8 independent whole RNG streams
sampling.C: two actual frames, each corresponding seed restored before complete sampling
sampling.D: two actual frames, each call progresses normal independent RNG stream; complete random states/noise hashes saved
sampling.full_noise: capture every torch.randn and randn_like result and before/after RNG states

response_measure: full generated H5 XYZ action sequence differences vs same-goal between-seed differences; first action not direction-error criterion
goal_legality: within official samplingXY .15/.20, >=.04 goal separation, one target changes, equal .08 distance from current cube, original renderer

decision_rules.encoding: goal current RGB changes and permutation-invariant foreground position/features/reconstruction; not particle-id identity
decision_rules.target_use: reproducible CRN G1vsG2 action changes >A numerical baseline weakens total goal-insensitivity; ratio toB is descriptive, not correctness
decision_rules.sampling: B vsC/D changes isolate sources; large variation alone is not harmful multimodality
decision_rules.validation: choose at most1 path after offline results; prereg separate matched complete runs, otherwise report not executed
